review: Ground material review uses the authoritative approved-game-reference.jpg. Earth and flora retain their existing source cells and contacts. The earlier ground sheet grass and first forest-floor-soft.png candidate were rejected: respectively wiry moss and long dry diagonal soil bands. Grass now uses the full untouched forest-floor-soft-v2.png after root comparison in actual portrait and landscape scenes, not separate user approval: lusher quiet olive/moss cover with smaller disconnected earth glimpses, fewer wiry strands and lower saturation than the previous grass-v2.png carpet. Exact prompt, actual references, hashes and rejection history are in forest_floor_soft_v2_generation.json. Distinct leaf groups and broad repeating motifs remain; actual-scale chapel portrait and courtyard landscape were compared; broad repetition remains a known limitation and final reference mood is not claimed. All ground sources are opaque orthographic top-down diffuse materials without baked canopy cast shadows, sun patches or isometric perspective; runtime supplies the120-degree ground projection and owner-linked shade.
